install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt -r backend/requirements-dev.txt

terminals.name: applypilot
terminals.command: test -f config/.env || cp config/.env.example config/.env; .venv/bin/python -c 'import uvicorn' && PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --app-dir backend
terminals.description: ApplyPilot API + dashboard on port 8000 (twice-daily scheduler enabled when secrets are present)
